primary.$description: Primary multilingual font family for Arabic and Latin. Unified Arabic/Latin typography via Cairo.

mono.$value: JetBrains Mono, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace
mono.$description: Monospace font family for code snippets, JSON schemas, and tabular telemetry data

regular.$description: Regular weight for body copy, paragraphs, and descriptive text

medium.$description: Medium weight for interactive controls, labels, and table headers

semibold.$description: Semibold weight for section headings and emphasized UI components

bold.$description: Bold weight for primary page titles and high-impact hero headings

xs.$description: 12px extra-small text for captions, timestamps, and helper annotations

sm.$description: 14px small text for form input labels, table cells, and secondary metadata

base.$description: 16px baseline body text size for all standard reading passages

lg.$description: 20px large text for subheadings and card titles

xl.$description: 24px extra-large text for section headings and modal dialog titles

2xl.$description: 30px heading for major view headers and dashboard titles

3xl.$description: 36px display heading for marketing titles and featured metrics

4xl.$description: 48px hero display heading for landing pages and high-impact showcases

tight.$description: 1.25 tight line height for headings and short-form callouts (Arabic baseline: 1.35)

normal.$description: 1.50 normal line height for standard body copy (Arabic baseline: 1.65)

relaxed.$description: 1.75 relaxed line height for long-form reading passages (Arabic baseline: 1.85)
